scope: PDF clause locators verified against the locally supplied ISO 32000-2:2020 text. Two-range coverage and strict physical source binding are verification policy; result aspects follow ADR 0015. No cryptographic validity is claimed.

requirements.description: Typed fields, signature dictionaries and UR3, including empty fields and encoded metadata.
Two ordered in-bounds ranges exclude exactly the physical hexadecimal Contents token. Signed chunks borrow original bytes.
requirements.gaps: Cryptographic digest and CMS verification are not implemented. Compressed signature dictionaries cannot establish a physical token binding.

requirements.description: Coverage matches parsed Prev-chain revision terminators and lists later revisions.
requirements.gaps: Repaired documents are inconclusive. Unconfirmed Prev-chain revision terminators are inconclusive. Historical fields removed or replaced by later revisions are not enumerated.

requirements.description: DocMDP permissions, FieldMDP selections, UR parameters and field locks are inert data.
requirements.gaps: Modification classification, rights enforcement and transform digest validation are not implemented.

requirements.description: Independent integrity, coverage, modification, trust, time, revocation and algorithm states follow ADR 0015 decision 2.
requirements.gaps: No cryptographic, trust, timestamp, revocation or algorithm verification is performed; legacy encodings are unsupported; adbe.pkcs7.sha1 is weak. The adbe.x509.rsa_sha1 name alone does not identify its digest (Table 260 note a).
